environment.evidence: safety and environmental policies and practices

shareholders.evidence: We must continuously achieve superior financial and operating results

integrity.evidence: Our commitment to high ethical standards, compliance and integrity

innovation.evidence: uses technology and innovation to help meet the world’s growing energy needs

result.analyst_notes: Factual, largely third-person corporate description that leads with scale, industry rank and history. Uses absolute language ("must") for financial results and ethics. Shareholders and integrity dominate; employees, customers, community and environment are barely addressed. Little aspirational or hedged language, and no stakeholder-directed commitments beyond ethics.
